description: Add an athlete to the roster, as the app's Add athlete form does: their name, and whatever else is known — email (one athlete per address across TriPeak), bio, coach notes, thresholds, goal races. A threshold that is not known is left out, never guessed: the plan works without it and says what is missing. Uses one of the plan's seats; when the plan is full it refuses and says so, with the billing link. Returns the new athlete's id and the two links to send them: their portal and their own MCP connector. send_invite: true also emails them their invitation (as send_athlete_invite) — ask the coach first.

bio.description: A line about them, as the athlete card shows it

email.description: Optional. Morning and weekly emails go here.

notes.description: Coach-only notes: injuries, life, what they are like to coach

send_invite.description: Email them their invitation straight away. Needs an email address.

target_races.description: Goal races, each {name, date, distanceType, priority, goalTime, location}.

distanceType.description: Sprint to 140.6 are triathlons; Hyrox is 8 × 1 km runs, each followed by a station; Custom is anything else.

name.description: Race name, e.g. "Ironman 70.3 Zell am See"

thresholds.description: Only the numbers known: ftpWatts (bike FTP, watts), weightKg (weight, kg), cssPaceSec100m (swim CSS, seconds per 100 m), runThresholdPaceSecKm (run threshold pace, seconds per km), maxHr (max heart rate, bpm), restingHr (resting heart rate, bpm), lthr (lactate threshold heart rate, bpm), cdA (aero drag area, m² (0.20–0.40)), crr (rolling resistance (0.0035–0.005)), carbsPerHour (race carb target, g/h), sex ("male" or "female"), birthYear (year of birth), poolLengthM (pool length, m (25 when unset)), wPrimeJ (W′, joules (15000–25000)).

name: add_athlete
